articles.headline: Security withdrawn from Fazl, family members
articles.summary: AI summary: Police and Federal Constabulary guards protecting JUI-F chief Fazlur Rehman and relatives in Islamabad and Dera Ismail Khan were reportedly pulled back, a move the party called a siege but an Islamabad police official said involved only one guard; opposition figures demanded the protection be restored, while police separately booked two JUI-F leaders and some 200 workers over a November 7 road blockade.

political.reason: Withdrawal of an opposition leader's security alongside anti-terrorism cases against party workers signals rising government-opposition friction.

social.reason: Party leaders cite threats to their safety, and the cases and arrest warrant add to tension on the streets.

market.reason: Minor relevance to markets unless the standoff escalates.

confidence.reason: Full article read, but the scale of the withdrawal is disputed between party and police sources.
